rules.conditions: the range is split at every P1 (AD and double-transit), P2 (Chara AD) and P3 (solar year) boundary; each segment is converged once; adjacent segments with identical outcome are merged
P4 inside a segment: S if any micro-window is S (interval = hull of S micro-windows), A only if every trigger result is A, else W; all-NE -> NE
T_adverse intents: E lists the pressure houses; output is framed as 'elevated pressure' windows and needs n >= min_n_for_label; no promise gate
